acceptance: The private spawning package owns a generic Pi registration/runtime boundary with no repository-relative or environment-selected host imports.

The repository host adapter statically injects the existing worker-tool implementation into that package boundary without changing role-declared admission, worker semantics, task authority, or evidence scope.
The launcher explicitly loads the repository adapter under --no-extensions; Mermaid remains separate; the evidence-validator profile remains separate; interactive project trust behavior is unchanged.
Focused package, adapter, launcher, worker, evidence-validator, Mermaid, package build, record, JSON, content, and whitespace validation passes.
The future independent installed-package host-services work is recorded as a lower-user-preference backlog item and is not claimed complete.
